(i) the flavor content of a dense neutrino ensemble is determined by the neutrino energy and the density of the ensemble; (ii) the flavor evolution of the ensemble can be described by a set of ordinary differential equations; (iii) the evolution equations can be written in a form that is independent of neutrino masses and the CP violating phase; and (iv) the equations have a simple interpretation in terms of neutrino oscillations.
the flavor evolution of a dense neutrino ensemble can be described by an effective two-flavor evolution with an effective mixing angle and effective mass-squared difference.
